informative_reading.note: The literal 0.70 forward-overlap rule is reported unchanged. This reading only states whether a firing is supported by a witness that could have failed to fire: a witness whose 3-px dilation covers >= 99% of the footprint overlaps every nonempty candidate, so its firing cannot distinguish drift from chance.

source_errors: The staged set is the complete contents of data/registry/rasters as cloned and hash-verified from the public owner-repository mirrors; a scan from this repository cannot certify that it is the complete inventory of every sibling lane, so the duplicate verdict is fail-closed (no certificate).
